name: EKODI User UI Shell
purpose: Keep one EKODI user experience while allowing each service to preserve its own visual family.

forbidden: service-specific copy of shared header runtime
admin navigation mixed into user header

footer.layout: centered single-column operator copy and legal links; wrap naturally on narrow screens
footer.themePolicy: inherit each service typography, palette and visual mood; optional --ekodi-user-footer-* tokens may refine it

language.placement: inside the adopted or fallback user header
language.persistence: ekodi_locale cookie scoped to .ekodi.kr with localStorage fallback
language.serviceContract: set html lang and data-ekodi-locale, translate shared chrome, dispatch ekodi:locale-change for service-owned content

pageTranslation.privacy: never translate form values, editable content, code, secrets or explicit no-translate regions

ambientAudio.placement: inside the adopted or fallback user header; floating only when no header exists

inheritance.hostRule: all public/workspace service hosts inherit the manifest service shell
inheritance.pathRule: all subordinate paths inherit their parent service shell
inheritance.rootServiceRule: ekodi.kr/<service>/... inherits that service when the route is a user surface

rules: header utilities stay compact and non-overlapping
service-owned palette, typography and content rhythm remain intact
